Body.Content:
Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights. When an administrator configures Application Insights data export for an environment, Power Apps automatically exports completed page loads, unhandled errors, supported Data API operations, and navigation initiated from generative pages without requiring telemetry code, the Application Insights JavaScript SDK, or a connection string on the page.

Availability

Field

Value

Release Channel

Weekly

2608.5

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/generative-pages#monitor-a-generative-page-with-application-insights-preview

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
